quests.instruction: What is the action word for running quickly with short, hurried steps?
quests.question: Scurry
quests.hint: Think about how a mouse dashes quickly across a kitchen floor.
quests.explanation: Scurry means to run quickly with short, hurried steps. Mice scurry across the floor!
quests.funFact: Many small creatures scurry away quickly to stay safe from bigger animals!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for moving somewhere suddenly and very fast?
quests.question: Dart
quests.hint: Think about a bird darting quickly from one branch to another.
quests.explanation: Dart means to move somewhere suddenly and fast. A bird can dart between branches!
quests.funFact: Darting movements are so fast they can be hard for our eyes to follow!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for moving somewhere very fast, almost like a rocket?
quests.question: Zoom
quests.hint: Think about a fast car zipping quickly down a long road.
quests.explanation: Zoom means to move very fast, almost like a rocket. Cars zoom down the highway!
quests.funFact: Rockets zoom so fast that they can even travel all the way into space!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for moving smoothly and quietly through the air or over ice?
quests.question: Glide
quests.hint: Think about an ice skater moving smoothly across the ice without any bumps.
quests.explanation: Glide means to move smoothly through the air or over a surface. Ice skaters glide across the rink!
quests.funFact: Gliding feels smooth because there is very little to slow the movement down!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for flying very high without flapping your wings much?
quests.question: Soar
quests.hint: Think about how an eagle glides high in the sky, barely flapping its wings.
quests.explanation: Soar means to fly very high, often gliding on the wind. Eagles soar high above the mountains!
quests.funFact: Eagles can soar for a long time using rising warm air instead of flapping their wings!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for staying still in one spot in the air without moving up or down?
quests.question: Hover
quests.hint: Think about how a helicopter can stay still in the air above one spot.
quests.explanation: Hover means to stay in one spot in the air. A helicopter can hover above the ground!
quests.funFact: Hummingbirds can hover in place by flapping their wings incredibly fast!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for resting gently on top of water or air without sinking?
quests.question: Float
quests.hint: Think about a leaf resting calmly on top of a pond.
quests.explanation: Float means to rest gently on top of water or air. A boat can float on the water!
quests.funFact: Things float when they are light enough for water to hold them up!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for slowly going down and disappearing under water?
quests.question: Sink
quests.hint: Think about what a heavy stone does when you drop it into a pond.
quests.explanation: Sink means to go down under water. A heavy stone will sink to the bottom of a pond!
quests.funFact: Heavy, dense objects usually sink, while light objects usually float!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for moving slowly and gently, carried by wind or water?
quests.question: Drift
quests.hint: Think about a leaf moving slowly along the top of a stream.
quests.explanation: Drift means to move slowly, carried along by wind or water. A leaf can drift down a stream!
quests.funFact: Clouds drift slowly across the sky, carried gently by the wind!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for hitting water so it flies up in little drops?
quests.question: Splash
quests.hint: Think about jumping into a pool and making water fly everywhere.
quests.explanation: Splash means to hit water so it flies up in drops. We splash and play in the pool!
quests.funFact: A big jump into water makes an even bigger, more exciting splash!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for walking slowly through water?
quests.question: Wade
quests.hint: Think about walking carefully through a shallow stream at the beach.
quests.explanation: Wade means to walk slowly through water. We wade through shallow water at the beach!
quests.funFact: Wading lets you enjoy the water while keeping your feet safely on the ground!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for jumping headfirst into water?
quests.question: Dive
quests.hint: Think about jumping off the side of a pool with your arms out in front.
quests.explanation: Dive means to jump headfirst into water. Swimmers dive into the pool to start a race!
quests.funFact: Divers keep their bodies straight and smooth to slip into the water easily!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for quickly drawing a simple, rough picture?
quests.question: Sketch
quests.hint: Think about drawing a quick, light outline before you add all the details.
quests.explanation: Sketch means to quickly draw a simple, rough picture. Artists sketch an idea before painting it!
quests.funFact: A quick sketch helps an artist plan out a picture before adding more detail!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for drawing small, playful shapes without a real plan?
quests.question: Doodle
quests.hint: Think about drawing little swirls and shapes on your notebook just for fun.
quests.explanation: Doodle means to draw small, playful shapes without a plan. We doodle in the corner of our notebook!
quests.funFact: Doodling for fun can actually help your brain relax and think creatively!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making something by hand with care and creativity?
quests.question: Craft
quests.hint: Think about making a homemade card using paper, glue, and glitter.
quests.explanation: Craft means to make something by hand with care. We craft cards and decorations!
quests.funFact: Crafting with your hands is a wonderful way to make something one of a kind!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for shaping clay or another material into a form?
quests.question: Sculpt
quests.hint: Think about squeezing and shaping soft clay into an animal shape.
quests.explanation: Sculpt means to shape a material, like clay, into a form. We sculpt little animals out of clay!
quests.funFact: Sculptors can shape clay, stone, or even ice into amazing works of art!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for crossing strips or threads over and under each other?
quests.question: Weave
quests.hint: Think about crossing paper strips over and under to make a pattern.
quests.explanation: Weave means to cross strips or threads over and under each other. We weave paper strips for crafts!
quests.funFact: Weaving over and under threads is how baskets and cloth are often made!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for looping yarn together with long needles to make fabric?
quests.question: Knit
quests.hint: Think about looping soft yarn again and again to make a warm scarf.
quests.explanation: Knit means to loop yarn together with needles to make fabric. We knit cozy scarves and hats!
quests.funFact: It can take many hours of careful knitting to finish just one warm scarf!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for joining fabric together using a needle and thread?
quests.question: Sew
quests.hint: Think about pushing a needle and thread through cloth to fix a small hole.
quests.explanation: Sew means to join fabric together with a needle and thread. We sew a button back onto a shirt!
quests.funFact: Sewing by hand takes patience, but it can fix or create so many things!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for pushing a thin string through the small hole of a needle?
quests.question: Thread
quests.hint: Think about carefully pushing a thin thread through a tiny needle hole.
quests.explanation: Thread means to push string through the hole of a needle. We thread a needle before we sew!
quests.funFact: Threading a needle takes a very steady hand and careful eyes!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using a sticky strip to join or fix paper?
quests.question: Tape
quests.hint: Think about using a sticky strip to fix a torn piece of paper.
quests.explanation: Tape means to use a sticky strip to join or fix things. We tape a torn paper back together!
quests.funFact: Tape is sticky on just one side, which helps it hold two things together!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for joining papers together using a small metal clip?
quests.question: Staple
quests.hint: Think about pressing a small tool that pushes a tiny metal pin through paper.
quests.explanation: Staple means to join papers with a small metal clip. We staple pages of a story together!
quests.funFact: A stapler pushes a tiny bent piece of metal through paper to hold pages together!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a hole using a spinning tool?
quests.question: Drill
quests.hint: Think about the spinning tool a builder uses to make a hole in wood.
quests.explanation: Drill means to make a hole using a spinning tool. Builders drill holes into wood!
quests.funFact: A drill spins very fast to make a clean, round hole quickly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for hammering a thin metal pin into wood to join pieces?
quests.question: Nail
quests.hint: Think about hammering a small metal pin into two pieces of wood to hold them together.
quests.explanation: Nail means to hammer a metal pin into wood to join pieces. Builders nail wood together!
quests.funFact: A nail has a sharp point that helps it push into wood easily!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for rubbing rough paper on wood to make it smooth?
quests.question: Sand
quests.hint: Think about rubbing a rough piece of paper back and forth over a wooden block.
quests.explanation: Sand means to rub rough paper on wood to make it smooth. We sand wood before we paint it!
quests.funFact: Sandpaper has tiny rough grains that gently smooth away bumps in wood!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for rubbing something to make it clean and shiny?
quests.question: Polish
quests.hint: Think about rubbing a cloth on your shoes to make them shiny.
quests.explanation: Polish means to rub something to make it clean and shiny. We polish our shoes before a special day!
quests.funFact: Polishing something again and again can make it sparkle like new!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using a hot, flat tool to smooth out wrinkles in clothes?
quests.question: Iron
quests.hint: Think about pressing a hot, flat tool over a wrinkled shirt.
quests.explanation: Iron means to use a hot, flat tool to smooth wrinkles. We iron our clothes before school!
quests.funFact: The heat from an iron gently smooths out wrinkly cloth!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using a machine to suck dirt and dust off the floor?
quests.question: Vacuum
quests.hint: Think about pushing a loud machine over the carpet to clean it.
quests.explanation: Vacuum means to use a machine to suck up dirt from the floor. We vacuum the carpet at home!
quests.funFact: A vacuum cleaner uses strong suction to pull tiny bits of dust off the floor!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using old materials again instead of throwing them away?
quests.question: Recycle
quests.hint: Think about putting an empty bottle into a special bin instead of the trash.
quests.explanation: Recycle means to use old materials again instead of throwing them away. We recycle paper and bottles!
quests.funFact: Recycling paper and plastic helps take good care of our whole planet!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for giving something you own to someone who needs it?
quests.question: Donate
quests.hint: Think about giving your old toys to a child who does not have many toys.
quests.explanation: Donate means to give something you own to someone who needs it. We donate toys we no longer use!
quests.funFact: Donating things you no longer need can bring real joy to someone else!
